newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks edge down as Dow recovers.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks edge down as Dow recovers.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks edged further downward, as the Dow Industrials regained about a third of yesterday's loss.
The Nasdaq Composite Index slipped 0.31 points, or 0.02 percent, to an unofficial close of 1292.97. The Dow Industrials rose 56.57 to 6935.46.
"Nasdaq stocks felt kind of weak today, sloppy," said a trader. "In general, this market has not had a great tone for the past few days."
"Techs were weak again today," he said.
Intel Corp was down 3-3/8 to 137-7/8 and Cisco Systems Inc fell 1-7/16 to 50-9/16.
But Oracle Corp rose 4-4/7 to 41 on better-than-expected earnings for the third quarter.

Leading the most actives was Employee Solutions Inc, which plummetted 9-1/8 to 6-1/4 after it confirmed that fourth quarter earnings would not meet expectations. This followed a 4-1/2 point tumble Thursday on the rumors confirmed today. Advancing and declining issues were neck-in-neck, 2092 to 2084, respectively.
Total trading volume was 601 million shares.
